item.title: Rajasthan panchayat in Jalore district bans camera phones for daughters-in-law
item.description: A village panchayat in Rajasthan's Jalore district has prohibited daughters-in-law and young women from 15 villages from using phones with cameras starting January 26 which is also India’s Republic Day, the day the Indian Constitution came into force.
